raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "fbbf478b91d04c3a9a73b1214b17c422::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is the immutable object a package name resolves to."}, {"item_id": "08e4e4f80eee496fbd276106b4ac608e::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Integrity threat D is that a compromised dependency is used."}, {"item_id": "08e4e4f80eee496fbd276106b4ac608e::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Integrity threat D applies threats A-H recursively."}, {"item_id": "e3e07c56ab4f41069ae146d1caac8952::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is an attestation recording the result of a prior verification."}, {"item_id": "e3e07c56ab4f41069ae146d1caac8952::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is used to make recursive dependency verification more efficient."}, {"item_id": "07018abc9c2f44d7b0d084de99ace049::verbatim_text", "attribute": "verbatim_text", "fact_text": "They are artifacts fetched during initialization or execution of the build process."}, {"item_id": "07018abc9c2f44d7b0d084de99ace049::verbatim_text", "attribute": "verbatim_text", "fact_text": "Such artifacts include configuration files, source artifacts, or build tools."}, {"item_id": "8c5591622a13472bafd827226c643714::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "These configurations are almost impossible to get right."}, {"item_id": "9eab346e0bc54eaf93aea4389d21b895::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "The build platform must have controls in place."}, {"item_id": "6837bd2a5c7245c285b979501260f95b::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "This option requires the mapping between artifact and attestation."}, {"item_id": "bf916c3f9b224e09aa122ce558edc328::verbatim_text", "attribute": "verbatim_text", "fact_text": "It is a set of rules and conventions governing how packages are distributed."}]}
